estimates.assumptions: 2 average skinless chicken breasts ≈ 400 g raw edible portion; plain poultry has zero carbohydrates
2 tbsp Thai red curry paste ≈ 40 g (typical commercial paste); typical values ~20 g carb / 100 g
2 tbsp full-fat coconut milk ≈ 30 g; typical values ~2 g carb / 100 g
1 medium red bell pepper chopped ≈ 120 g edible portion; typical values ~6.2 g carb / 100 g
1 medium courgette/zucchini chopped ≈ 200 g edible portion; typical values ~3.3 g carb / 100 g
1 medium red onion in thin wedges ≈ 110 g edible portion; typical values ~9 g carb / 100 g
Lime to serve (1 lime, ~100 g with peel) contributes ~7 g total carbs including fiber to whole recipe
